SPECIAL MEETING
OF THE CITY COUNCIL
AND THE CITY COUNCIL AS THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE
REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - AUGUST 23, 2012 - CITY HALL -
07:00 P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
A G E N D A
Public input will be allowed on all Agenda items at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered.
1.
Call to Order
2.
Invocation
3.
Pledge of Allegiance
4.
Roll Call
5.
Presentations
6.
Public Comments and Suggestions
CONSENT CALENDAR
7.
Approval of Registers of Demands
A.
City of Cerritos dated August 23, 2012. (COUNCIL)
approve the Register of Demands dated August 23, 2012 in the total amount of $7,140,3686.91
B.
Successor Agency dated August 23, 2012.
(SUCCESSOR AGENCY)
approve the Register of Demands dated August 23, 2012 in the total amount of $3,300.00
8.
Approval of Minutes
A.
City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting of
August 9, 2012. (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY)
approve the City Council/Successor Agency regular meeting minutes of August 9, 2012.
9.
Miscellaneous
A.
Consideration and award of Bid No. 1145-13, Printing of the Cerritos Center for the Performing Arts 2012-2013 Fall Mini Calendar. (COUNCIL)
award Bid No. 1145-13 to Freedom Printing for the Printing of the Cerritos Center for the Performing Arts 2012-2013 Fall Mini Calendar in the total amount of $6,413.91.
10.
Ordinance for second reading and adoption. Reading of ordinance waived at introduction.
A.
ORDINANCE NO. 971 - AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS ADDING CHAPTER 9.47 TO TITLE 9 OF THE CERRITOS MUNICIPAL CODE TO PROHIBIT REGISTERED SEX OFFENDERS FROM ENTERING INTO OR UPON CITY OWNED FACILITIES AND LOITERING THEREON. (COUNCIL)
waive reading and adopt Ordinance No. 971 entitled: AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS ADDING CHAPTER 9.47 TO TITLE 9 OF THE CERRITOS MUNICIPAL CODE TO PROHIBIT REGISTERED SEX OFFENDERS FROM ENTERING INTO OR UPON CITY OWNED FACILITIES AND LOITERING THEREON.
End of Consent Calendar
11.
Public Hearings
A.
A REQUEST BY PROPERTY OWNER WALTON CWCA O’DONNEL CERRITOS 46, LLC, 1800 EAST IMPERIAL HIGHWAY, SUITE 205, BREA, CALIFORNIA, 92821, FOR APPROVAL OF A CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT FOR WAREHOUSING, DISTRIBUTION AND WHOLESALE USES AT 15928 COMMERCE WAY, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, 90703. THE SUBJECT PROPERTY IS ZONED INDUSTRIAL (M) (APN 7005-013-065). (COUNCIL) CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT 2012-3* *PURSUANT TO SECTION 15301 OF THE CALIFORNIA ENVIRONMENTAL QUALITY ACT (CEQA), THIS PROJECT IS CATEGORICALLY EXEMPT.
approve Conditional Use Permit 2012-3, making the findings set forth in Cerritos Planning Commission Resolution No. PC 2012-26.
B.
A REQUEST BY APPLICANT ASPECTUS, INC., 33672 HOLTZ HILL ROAD, DANA POINT, CALIFORNIA, 92629 ON BEHALF OF CROWN CASTLE TO REMOVE AND REPLACE THREE (3) EXISTING SOUTHERN CALIFORNIA EDISON (SCE) STREET LIGHT POLES LOCATED IN THE PUBLIC RIGHT-OF-WAY WITH NEW STREET LIGHT POLES, POLE-MOUNTED WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATION ANTENNAS, AND RELATED SUPPORT EQUIPMENT AS PART OF A DISTRIBUTED ANTENNA SYSTEM. (COUNCIL)
1. WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATION PERMIT 2012-1* (12210U PALM STREET)
2. WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATION PERMIT 2012-2* (12800U ARTESIA BOULEVARD)
3. WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATION PERMIT 2012-3* (13130 183RD STREET)
*PURSUANT TO SECTION 15303 OF THE CALIFORNIA ENVIRONMENTAL QUALITY ACT (CEQA), THIS PROJECT IS CATEGORICALLY EXEMPT.
1. Approve Wireless Telecommunication Permit 2012-1, making the findings set forth in Cerritos Planning Commission Resolution No. PC 2012-28.
2. Approve Wireless Telecommunication Permit 2012-2, making the findings set forth in Cerritos Planning Commission Resolution No. PC 2012-29.
3. Approve Wireless Telecommunication Permit 2012-3, making the findings set forth in Cerritos Planning Commission Resolution No. PC 2012-30.
C.
Consideration to waive reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS FINDING THE CITY IN CONFORMANCE WITH THE CONGESTION MANAGEMENT PROGRAM (CMP) AND ADOPTING THE 2012 CMP LOCAL DEVELOPMENT REPORT, IN ACCORDANCE WITH CALIFORNIA GOVERNMENT CODE SECTION 65089. (COUNCIL)
conduct a public hearing, waive further reading of and adopt the captioned resolution certifying that Cerritos is in compliance with the requirements of the Congestion Management Program: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS FINDING THE CITY IN CONFORMANCE WITH THE CONGESTION MANAGEMENT PROGRAM (CMP) AND ADOPTING THE 2012 CMP LOCAL DEVELOPMENT REPORT, IN ACCORDANCE WITH CALIFORNIA GOVERNMENT CODE SECTION 65089.
12.
New and Old Business
A.
Consideration to waive reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY SETTING FORTH CERTAIN ORGANIZATIONAL MATTERS PERTAINING TO THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY. (SUCCESSOR AGENCY)
Review, consider, waive reading of, and adopt a resolution, captioned: A RESOLUTION OF THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY SETTING FORTH CERTAIN ORGANIZATIONAL MATTERS PERTAINING TO THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY.
B.
Consideration of participation in a pilot program to install plug-in vehicle charging stations at the Cerritos Civic Center; and authorization for the City Manager to execute a Municipal License Agreement for the installation and operation of two (2) plug-in vehicle charging stations. (COUNCIL)
1. Approve City of Cerritos participation in a pilot program to install plug-in vehicle charging stations at the Cerritos Civic Center; and
2. Authorize the City Manager to execute a municpal license agreement with ECOtality for the installation and operation of two (2) plug-in vehicle charging stations.
C.
Consideration and award of contract for Cerritos Swim Center Extraordinary Maintenance. (COUNCIL)
award a contract for ongoing Cerritos Swim center extraordinary maintenance to Service 1st Contractors.
D.
Consideration and award of contract for annual plumbing maintenance for the City of Cerritos. (COUNCIL)
award a contract for annual ongoing plumbing maintenance to Norwalk/La Mirada Plumbing & HVAC.
E.
Review of 2013 City Council/Successor Agency meeting dates and possible rescheduling of dates conflicting with holidays and/or other events. (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY)
review the following modifications to the 2013 Council/Agency meeting calendar and direct staff accordingly.
13.
Legislative Items
A.
Report on Pending Legislation.
B.
Action to support or oppose specific legislation pending in the California Legislature or pending in the California Governor's Office for signature.
14.
City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Report on Meetings
15.
Adjournment
